title_vi: Động từ + dạng -ing và động từ nguyên mẫu (1)
theory_html:
A. Object + -ing or possessive + -ing

A. Tân ngữ + -ing hoặc sở hữu + -ing

Some verbs can be followed either by an object + -ing or a possessive + -ing with a similar meaning, although the possessive + -ing form is usually considered to be rather formal:

Một số động từ có thể đi với tân ngữ + V-ing hoặc sở hữu + V-ing với nghĩa tương tự, dù dạng sở hữu + V-ing thường được coi là khá trang trọng:

  • I resented Tom winning the prize. (more formally I resented Tom’s winning the prize.)

    Tôi bực bội vì Tom giành giải.

  • Mia recalled him buying the book. (more formally Mia recalled his buying the book.)

    Mia nhớ lại việc anh ấy mua cuốn sách.

Also: detest, (dis)approve of, (dis)like, hate, love, object to (= ‘(dis)liking’ verbs); forget, imagine, remember, think of (= ‘thinking’ verbs)

Tương tự: detest, (dis)approve of, (dis)like, hate, love, object to (= động từ ‘thích/ghét’); forget, imagine, remember, think of (= động từ ‘suy nghĩ’)

Note that we only use a possessive form (Tom’s, his) here to talk about a person or group of people:

Lưu ý: chỉ dùng dạng sở hữu (Tom’s, his) ở đây khi nói về người hoặc nhóm người:

  • I remember the horse winning the race. (but not … the horse’s winning …)

    Tôi nhớ con ngựa thắng cuộc đua.

B. to (preposition) + -ing

B. to (giới từ) + -ing

Some verbs can be followed by to + -ing where to is a preposition:

Một số động từ đi với to + V-ing, trong đó to là giới từ:

  • She confessed to stealing the money.

    Cô ấy thú nhận đã lấy trộm tiền.

  • You don’t object to working late tonight, do you?

    Bạn không phản đối làm muộn tối nay chứ?

Also: adapt, adjust, admit, look forward, own up, resort

Tương tự: adapt, adjust, admit, look forward, own up, resort

Note that these verbs can also be followed by to + noun phrase: She confessed to the crime. / You don’t object to the work, do you?

Lưu ý: các động từ này cũng có thể đi với to + cụm danh từ: Cô ấy thú nhận tội. / Bạn không phản đối công việc chứ?

C. Other prepositions + -ing

C. Các giới từ khác + -ing

Other verbs can be followed by different prepositions + -ing. For example:

Các động từ khác có thể đi với những giới từ khác + V-ing. Ví dụ:

by + -ing (begin, close, end, finish (off / up), open, start (off / out)):

by + V-ing (begin, close, end, finish (off / up), open, start (off / out)):

  • Can you begin by cleaning the floors, and then do the windows?

    Bạn bắt đầu bằng việc lau sàn rồi đến cửa sổ được không?

on + -ing or on + object + -ing (concentrate, count, depend, focus, insist, rely):

on + V-ing hoặc on + tân ngữ + V-ing (concentrate, count, depend, focus, insist, rely):

  • Clare insisted on (Jack) wearing a suit to the party.

    Clare nhất quyết đòi (Jack) mặc vest đến bữa tiệc.

of + -ing or of + object + -ing (approve, hear, know, speak, talk, tell):

of + V-ing hoặc of + tân ngữ + V-ing (approve, hear, know, speak, talk, tell):

  • Have you ever heard of (anyone) getting arrested for gossiping before?

    Bạn đã bao giờ nghe nói (có ai) bị bắt vì buôn chuyện chưa?

object + from + -ing (deter, discourage, keep, prevent, prohibit, stop):

tân ngữ + from + V-ing (deter, discourage, keep, prevent, prohibit, stop):

  • The noise from next door prevented me from sleeping.

    Tiếng ồn nhà bên khiến tôi không ngủ được.

D. Object + -ing or bare infinitive after verbs of perception

D. Tân ngữ + -ing hoặc V nguyên mẫu sau động từ tri giác

Some verbs (feel, hear, notice, observe, overhear, see, watch) can be followed by an object and then either by an -ing form or bare infinitive, but the meanings may be slightly different. Compare:

Một số động từ (feel, hear, notice, observe, overhear, see, watch) có thể đi với tân ngữ rồi đến V-ing hoặc V nguyên mẫu, nhưng nghĩa có thể hơi khác. So sánh:

  • I saw them playing football from my window. (-ing indicates an action in progress)

    Tôi thấy họ đang chơi bóng từ cửa sổ. (-ing chỉ hành động đang diễn ra)

  • I saw him smash the bottle. (bare infinitive indicates a completed action)

    Tôi thấy anh ta đập vỡ cái chai. (V nguyên mẫu chỉ hành động trọn vẹn)

  • I was able to watch them building the new car park from my office window. (-ing suggests that I watched, but not from start to finish)

    Từ cửa sổ văn phòng tôi có thể xem họ xây bãi đỗ xe mới. (-ing: xem nhưng không từ đầu đến cuối)

  • I watched him climb through the window, and then I called the police. (bare infinitive suggests I watched the whole action from start to finish)

    Tôi nhìn hắn trèo qua cửa sổ rồi gọi cảnh sát. (V nguyên mẫu: xem toàn bộ hành động)

E. dare, help; have, let, make

After the verbs dare and help we can use either a bare infinitive or to-infinitive:

Sau dare và help có thể dùng V nguyên mẫu hoặc to-V:

  • I was angry with him, but I didn’t dare (to) say anything.

    Tôi giận anh ta, nhưng không dám nói gì.

  • We hope the Twitter campaign will help (to) raise awareness of the problem.

    Chúng tôi hy vọng chiến dịch Twitter sẽ giúp nâng cao nhận thức về vấn đề.

When dare has an object, we can only use a to-infinitive. Compare:

Khi dare có tân ngữ, chỉ dùng to-V. So sánh:

  • I dared him to cross the river. (not I dared him cross …) / I helped them (to) pack.

    Tôi thách anh ấy bơi qua sông. / Tôi giúp họ đóng gói đồ.

After have, let and make we can use an object + bare infinitive but not to-infinitive:

Sau have, let, make dùng tân ngữ + V nguyên mẫu, không dùng to-V:

  • His exam results might make him work harder. (not … might make him to work …)

    Kết quả thi có thể khiến cậu ấy học chăm hơn.

  • I had Irena clean up her bedroom before I let her go out to play.

    Tôi bắt Irena dọn phòng trước khi cho con bé ra ngoài chơi.

mcq.question: I resented ___ winning the prize. (more formal)
mcq.full: I resented Tom’s winning the prize. (more formal)
mcq.vi: Tôi bực bội vì Tom giành giải.
mcq.expl:
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + object + -ing or possessive + -ing (formal); possessive only for people.
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + tân ngữ + V-ing hoặc sở hữu + V-ing (trang trọng); dạng sở hữu chỉ dùng cho người.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Trang trọng: sở hữu + V-ing.
mcq.key: I resented ___ winning the prize. (more formal)|Tom’s

mcq.question: Mia recalled ___ buying the book. (more formal)
mcq.full: Mia recalled his buying the book. (more formal)
mcq.vi: Mia nhớ lại việc anh ấy mua cuốn sách.
mcq.expl:
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + object + -ing or possessive + -ing (formal); possessive only for people.
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + tân ngữ + V-ing hoặc sở hữu + V-ing (trang trọng); dạng sở hữu chỉ dùng cho người.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Trang trọng: his + V-ing.
mcq.key: Mia recalled ___ buying the book. (more formal)|his

mcq.question: I remember ___ winning the race.
mcq.full: I remember the horse winning the race.
mcq.vi: Tôi nhớ con ngựa thắng cuộc đua.
mcq.expl:
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + object + -ing or possessive + -ing (formal); possessive only for people.
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + tân ngữ + V-ing hoặc sở hữu + V-ing (trang trọng); dạng sở hữu chỉ dùng cho người.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Không dùng sở hữu cho con vật.
mcq.key: I remember ___ winning the race.|the horse

mcq.question: I really hate ___ having to be away from home so much. (more formal)
mcq.full: I really hate your having to be away from home so much. (more formal)
mcq.vi: Tôi rất ghét việc bạn phải xa nhà nhiều như vậy.
mcq.expl:
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + object + -ing or possessive + -ing (formal); possessive only for people.
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + tân ngữ + V-ing hoặc sở hữu + V-ing (trang trọng); dạng sở hữu chỉ dùng cho người.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Trang trọng: your + V-ing.
mcq.key: I really hate ___ having to be away from home so much. (more formal)|your

mcq.question: We don’t approve of ___ locating the factory so close to houses. (more formal)
mcq.full: We don’t approve of the developer’s locating the factory so close to houses. (more formal)
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi không tán thành việc chủ đầu tư đặt nhà máy quá gần nhà dân.
mcq.expl:
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + object + -ing or possessive + -ing (formal); possessive only for people.
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + tân ngữ + V-ing hoặc sở hữu + V-ing (trang trọng); dạng sở hữu chỉ dùng cho người.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Sở hữu + V-ing.
mcq.key: We don’t approve of ___ locating the factory so close to houses. (more formal)|the developer’s

mcq.question: It is difficult to imagine ___ accepting the decision without any objection. (more formal)
mcq.full: It is difficult to imagine his accepting the decision without any objection. (more formal)
mcq.vi: Khó mà tưởng tượng anh ta chấp nhận quyết định mà không phản đối gì.
mcq.expl:
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + object + -ing or possessive + -ing (formal); possessive only for people.
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + tân ngữ + V-ing hoặc sở hữu + V-ing (trang trọng); dạng sở hữu chỉ dùng cho người.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Sở hữu + V-ing.
mcq.key: It is difficult to imagine ___ accepting the decision without any objection. (more formal)|his

mcq.question: I remember ___ arguing a great deal when they were children. (more formal)
mcq.full: I remember their arguing a great deal when they were children. (more formal)
mcq.vi: Tôi nhớ chúng cãi nhau rất nhiều hồi nhỏ.
mcq.expl:
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + object + -ing or possessive + -ing (formal); possessive only for people.
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + tân ngữ + V-ing hoặc sở hữu + V-ing (trang trọng); dạng sở hữu chỉ dùng cho người.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Sở hữu + V-ing.
mcq.key: I remember ___ arguing a great deal when they were children. (more formal)|their

mcq.question: No one heard ___ shouting for help.
mcq.full: No one heard the man shouting for help.
mcq.vi: Không ai nghe thấy người đàn ông kêu cứu.
mcq.expl:
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + object + -ing or possessive + -ing (formal); possessive only for people.
(dis)like / hate / approve of / remember / imagine / forget + tân ngữ + V-ing hoặc sở hữu + V-ing (trang trọng); dạng sở hữu chỉ dùng cho người.
Điểm ngữ pháp: hear không phải động từ thích/ghét hay suy nghĩ → không dùng sở hữu.
mcq.key: No one heard ___ shouting for help.|the man

mcq.question: She confessed to ___ the money.
mcq.full: She confessed to stealing the money.
mcq.vi: Cô ấy thú nhận đã lấy trộm tiền.
mcq.expl:
confess / object / admit / adapt / adjust / look forward / own up / resort + to + -ing (to is a preposition).
confess / object / admit / adapt / adjust / look forward / own up / resort + to + V-ing (to là giới từ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: to (giới từ) + V-ing.
mcq.key: She confessed to ___ the money.|stealing

mcq.question: You don’t object to ___ late tonight, do you?
mcq.full: You don’t object to working late tonight, do you?
mcq.vi: Bạn không phản đối làm muộn tối nay chứ?
mcq.expl:
confess / object / admit / adapt / adjust / look forward / own up / resort + to + -ing (to is a preposition).
confess / object / admit / adapt / adjust / look forward / own up / resort + to + V-ing (to là giới từ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: object to + V-ing.
mcq.key: You don’t object to ___ late tonight, do you?|working

mcq.question: In a survey, 65% of dentists ___ making mistakes in treating patients.
mcq.full: In a survey, 65% of dentists owned up to making mistakes in treating patients.
mcq.vi: Trong một khảo sát, 65% nha sĩ thừa nhận đã mắc lỗi khi điều trị bệnh nhân.
mcq.expl:
confess / object / admit / adapt / adjust / look forward / own up / resort + to + -ing (to is a preposition).
confess / object / admit / adapt / adjust / look forward / own up / resort + to + V-ing (to là giới từ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: own up to + V-ing.
mcq.key: In a survey, 65% of dentists ___ making mistakes in treating patients.|owned up to

mcq.question: I grew up in the countryside, and I found it difficult to adapt to ___ in a big city.
mcq.full: I grew up in the countryside, and I found it difficult to adapt to living in a big city.
mcq.vi: Tôi lớn lên ở nông thôn và thấy khó thích nghi với việc sống ở thành phố lớn.
mcq.expl:
confess / object / admit / adapt / adjust / look forward / own up / resort + to + -ing (to is a preposition).
confess / object / admit / adapt / adjust / look forward / own up / resort + to + V-ing (to là giới từ).
Điểm ngữ pháp: adapt to + V-ing.
mcq.key: I grew up in the countryside, and I found it difficult to adapt to ___ in a big city.|living

mcq.question: Can you begin ___ cleaning the floors, and then do the windows?
mcq.full: Can you begin by cleaning the floors, and then do the windows?
mcq.vi: Bạn bắt đầu bằng việc lau sàn rồi đến cửa sổ được không?
mcq.expl:
begin / end by + -ing; insist / rely / depend on + -ing; approve / hear / know of + -ing; prevent / stop / discourage + object + from + -ing.
begin / end by + V-ing; insist / rely / depend on + V-ing; approve / hear / know of + V-ing; prevent / stop / discourage + tân ngữ + from + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: begin by + V-ing.
mcq.key: Can you begin ___ cleaning the floors, and then do the windows?|by

mcq.question: Clare insisted ___ Jack wearing a suit to the party.
mcq.full: Clare insisted on Jack wearing a suit to the party.
mcq.vi: Clare nhất quyết đòi Jack mặc vest đến bữa tiệc.
mcq.expl:
begin / end by + -ing; insist / rely / depend on + -ing; approve / hear / know of + -ing; prevent / stop / discourage + object + from + -ing.
begin / end by + V-ing; insist / rely / depend on + V-ing; approve / hear / know of + V-ing; prevent / stop / discourage + tân ngữ + from + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: insist on + O + V-ing.
mcq.key: Clare insisted ___ Jack wearing a suit to the party.|on

mcq.question: Have you ever heard ___ anyone getting arrested for gossiping before?
mcq.full: Have you ever heard of anyone getting arrested for gossiping before?
mcq.vi: Bạn đã bao giờ nghe nói có ai bị bắt vì buôn chuyện chưa?
mcq.expl:
begin / end by + -ing; insist / rely / depend on + -ing; approve / hear / know of + -ing; prevent / stop / discourage + object + from + -ing.
begin / end by + V-ing; insist / rely / depend on + V-ing; approve / hear / know of + V-ing; prevent / stop / discourage + tân ngữ + from + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: hear of + O + V-ing.
mcq.key: Have you ever heard ___ anyone getting arrested for gossiping before?|of

mcq.question: The noise from next door prevented me ___ sleeping.
mcq.full: The noise from next door prevented me from sleeping.
mcq.vi: Tiếng ồn nhà bên khiến tôi không ngủ được.
mcq.expl:
begin / end by + -ing; insist / rely / depend on + -ing; approve / hear / know of + -ing; prevent / stop / discourage + object + from + -ing.
begin / end by + V-ing; insist / rely / depend on + V-ing; approve / hear / know of + V-ing; prevent / stop / discourage + tân ngữ + from + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: prevent + O + from + V-ing.
mcq.key: The noise from next door prevented me ___ sleeping.|from

mcq.question: I don’t think children should wear jewellery in school. → I don’t approve ___ children wearing jewellery in school.
mcq.full: I don’t think children should wear jewellery in school. → I don’t approve of children wearing jewellery in school.
mcq.vi: Tôi không nghĩ trẻ em nên đeo trang sức ở trường. → Tôi không tán thành việc trẻ em đeo trang sức ở trường.
mcq.expl:
begin / end by + -ing; insist / rely / depend on + -ing; approve / hear / know of + -ing; prevent / stop / discourage + object + from + -ing.
begin / end by + V-ing; insist / rely / depend on + V-ing; approve / hear / know of + V-ing; prevent / stop / discourage + tân ngữ + from + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: approve of + O + V-ing.
mcq.key: I don’t think children should wear jewellery in school. → I don’t approve ___ children wearing jewellery in school.|of

mcq.question: I would like to finish with a summary of the main points. → I would like to end ___ summarising the main points.
mcq.full: I would like to finish with a summary of the main points. → I would like to end by summarising the main points.
mcq.vi: Tôi muốn kết thúc bằng phần tóm tắt các ý chính. → Tôi muốn kết thúc bằng việc tóm tắt các ý chính.
mcq.expl:
begin / end by + -ing; insist / rely / depend on + -ing; approve / hear / know of + -ing; prevent / stop / discourage + object + from + -ing.
begin / end by + V-ing; insist / rely / depend on + V-ing; approve / hear / know of + V-ing; prevent / stop / discourage + tân ngữ + from + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: end by + V-ing.
mcq.key: I would like to finish with a summary of the main points. → I would like to end ___ summarising the main points.|by

mcq.question: My parents said they thought I shouldn’t go to university. → My parents discouraged me ___ going to university.
mcq.full: My parents said they thought I shouldn’t go to university. → My parents discouraged me from going to university.
mcq.vi: Bố mẹ nói họ nghĩ tôi không nên học đại học. → Bố mẹ ngăn cản tôi học đại học.
mcq.expl:
begin / end by + -ing; insist / rely / depend on + -ing; approve / hear / know of + -ing; prevent / stop / discourage + object + from + -ing.
begin / end by + V-ing; insist / rely / depend on + V-ing; approve / hear / know of + V-ing; prevent / stop / discourage + tân ngữ + from + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: discourage + O + from + V-ing.
mcq.key: My parents said they thought I shouldn’t go to university. → My parents discouraged me ___ going to university.|from

mcq.question: You can’t trust Sophie to turn up on time. → You can’t rely ___ Sophie turning up on time.
mcq.full: You can’t trust Sophie to turn up on time. → You can’t rely on Sophie turning up on time.
mcq.vi: Không thể tin Sophie đến đúng giờ. → Không thể trông cậy vào việc Sophie đến đúng giờ.
mcq.expl:
begin / end by + -ing; insist / rely / depend on + -ing; approve / hear / know of + -ing; prevent / stop / discourage + object + from + -ing.
begin / end by + V-ing; insist / rely / depend on + V-ing; approve / hear / know of + V-ing; prevent / stop / discourage + tân ngữ + from + V-ing.
Điểm ngữ pháp: rely on + O + V-ing.
mcq.key: You can’t trust Sophie to turn up on time. → You can’t rely ___ Sophie turning up on time.|on

mcq.question: I saw them ___ football from my window. (an action in progress)
mcq.full: I saw them playing football from my window. (an action in progress)
mcq.vi: Tôi thấy họ đang chơi bóng từ cửa sổ.
mcq.expl:
see / hear / watch / feel + object + -ing (in progress, not the whole action) or + bare infinitive (completed / whole action).
see / hear / watch / feel + tân ngữ + V-ing (đang diễn ra, không trọn vẹn) hoặc + V nguyên mẫu (hành động trọn vẹn).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Hành động đang diễn ra → V-ing.
mcq.key: I saw them ___ football from my window. (an action in progress)|playing

mcq.question: I saw him ___ the bottle. (a completed action)
mcq.full: I saw him smash the bottle. (a completed action)
mcq.vi: Tôi thấy anh ta đập vỡ cái chai.
mcq.expl:
see / hear / watch / feel + object + -ing (in progress, not the whole action) or + bare infinitive (completed / whole action).
see / hear / watch / feel + tân ngữ + V-ing (đang diễn ra, không trọn vẹn) hoặc + V nguyên mẫu (hành động trọn vẹn).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Hành động trọn vẹn → V nguyên mẫu.
mcq.key: I saw him ___ the bottle. (a completed action)|smash

mcq.question: I watched him ___ through the window, and then I called the police. (the whole action)
mcq.full: I watched him climb through the window, and then I called the police. (the whole action)
mcq.vi: Tôi nhìn hắn trèo qua cửa sổ rồi gọi cảnh sát.
mcq.expl:
see / hear / watch / feel + object + -ing (in progress, not the whole action) or + bare infinitive (completed / whole action).
see / hear / watch / feel + tân ngữ + V-ing (đang diễn ra, không trọn vẹn) hoặc + V nguyên mẫu (hành động trọn vẹn).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Toàn bộ hành động → V nguyên mẫu.
mcq.key: I watched him ___ through the window, and then I called the police. (the whole action)|climb

mcq.question: I heard the tyre ___ and then the lorry skidded across the road.
mcq.full: I heard the tyre burst and then the lorry skidded across the road.
